protocol.selection: Two prespecified family transfers; no candidate/parameter sweep. All results retained. Rules frozen before development/validation comparison.
protocol.changes: M5/M1 closed execution, explicit shorter 20/5-minute holds and smaller fixed stop/target; original configurations unchanged. New performance is not inferred from old family performance.
protocol.validation: October 2026, known market period from prior research
protocol.costs: Real retained bid/ask ticks, $3.50/lot/side, .02/.05 slippage, 200/500ms delays, .01lot floors,100oz/lot,100x leverage
protocol.acceptance: Strong positive expectancy and cost stress resilience in both months, adequate independent decisions, viable after $100 fee; no promotion of 1–10% monthly small-account cases as meeting the aggressive objective.
